headline: "A good designer is a good listener first" says Martin Lotti
context: Nike chief design officer Martin Lotti has joined Dezeen Awards 2026 as a judge. As the 2026 World Cup kicks off, he talks to Dezeen about five key projects that best represent his approach to design. Lotti has been at the helm of Nike's creative vision for nearly three decades.
